correctness.rationale: Exact model and allowed payoff hypotheses reconstructed from arXiv:2610.03173v1. The weighted-divergence identity strictly excludes cycles for σm≤4. For the η-family, logistic fixed-point monotonicity proves unique DFE and endemic equilibrium; rational Jacobian identities prove saddle and hyperbolic repelling focus; low-infection strip proves uniform persistence of every interior trajectory; standard planar Poincaré–Bendixson implies periodic omega-limits. Replaying extracted dependency-free verify.py passed 136 exact rational checks and 5320 finite samples; these supplement but do not replace the proof. No assertion of cycle uniqueness or stability.
